text:
Marta (People Ops): Quick drop — building a short 'evidence-first' self-review template so ICs focus on outcomes + supporting evidence, not long narratives.
Jules (Manager): love this. can you add a one-line impact + 2-3 evidence bullets? that's what i want in 1:1s.
Marta (People Ops): that's the plan. draft below — feedback welcome:
Marta (People Ops): 1) One-line impact (40 chars-ish): "Reduced LLM inference cost per 1k tokens by 35%" 
Marta (People Ops): 2) Evidence bullets (2-4):
Marta (People Ops): - shipped quantization pipeline; benchmarks: 35% lower p50 cost vs baseline
Marta (People Ops): - rolled out on prod to 3 services; saved ~$18k/mo on average
Marta (People Ops): - guidance doc + migration PRs (links)
Marta (People Ops): 3) Stretch / how i moved the team: "led cross-team runbooks + training"
Drew (Eng): can we add a quick 'what i learned' bullet? for dev growth signal.
Marta (People Ops): yes—make it optional: "Learned: better KV cache eviction param tuning, reduced tail latency by 12%"
Lei (IC): quick Q — does this replace the longer self-review sections? our directors like context.
Marta (People Ops): not replace — use as the top-summary. below that capture context + blockers + ask for manager.
Jules (Manager): for managers: please prepare one sentence of coaching guidance for each IC using 'what's next' phrasing.
Marta (People Ops): I'll add manager micro-templates. draft manager lines:
Marta (People Ops): - "Great impact on cost; prioritize MLP rollout to remaining services; I'll support with 2 triage sessions." 
Marta (People Ops): - "Focus next on latency regressions; pair with infra for SLA gating." 
Drew (Eng): these are nice. Can we include a tiny checkbox list for calibration calls?
Marta (People Ops): yes. proposed calibration checklist:
Marta (People Ops): - [ ] One-line impact exists
Marta (People Ops): - [ ] Evidence bullets (2+)
Marta (People Ops): - [ ] Manager coaching line present
Marta (People Ops): - [ ] Any conflicts / cross-team dependencies noted
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: self-review window opens Mon 05/13 — automated calendar invites sent.
Lei (IC): awesome. can you add a 2-sentence example self-review filled out top-to-bottom?
Marta (People Ops): example:
Marta (People Ops): "One-line impact: Cut token costs by 35% for search-ranking pipeline.\nEvidence:\n- Implemented 8-bit quantization with validation harness; 35% avg cost reduction.\n- Deployed gradual rollout to prod; measured 0.4s p95 improvement on heavy queries.\nManager note: Continue rollout, pair with infra to ensure IO throughput." 
Jules (Manager): perfect. can we make a one-pager to paste into the review form? short, copyable.
Marta (People Ops): will do. intent is 'paste-and-go' for ICs, and 'snackable' coaching lines for managers. any final asks?
Drew (Eng): link to the quantization benchmark doc would be great in the template. maybe a slot "links:" 
Marta (People Ops): good call. will add 'links:' section at end. i'll publish v1 by Fri and ping channel. :raised_hands:
Lei (IC): thanks! saving this for my review.
PeopleOpsBot: Note: Calibration meeting scheduled Thu 05/23 10:00 — RSVP if you're a manager.
Marta (People Ops): thanks everyone — wrapping up action items: (1) publish template v1, (2) manager micro-phrases doc, (3) add links slot. ping if you want edits.
